title: Clearing every customer shows the empty state with a zero totals row
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report with data on screen.
steps: 1. Open the Customer filter and activate "Clear all" so no customer is selected.
2. Read the table body and the totals row.
expected: 1. The report shows the empty-state message "No sales data found for the selected filters."
3. The Customer filter's collapsed label reads "None."
